parameters.query:
-- Web roster upload tables (created once, idempotent)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roster_automation_flow_engineers (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  role VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Engineer',
  email VARCHAR(100),
  phone VARCHAR(20),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roster_automation_flow_roster (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  engineer_id INT NOT NULL,
  date DATE NOT NULL,
  shift_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  last_updated TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (engineer_id) REFERENCES roster_automation_flow_engineers(id),
  UNIQUE KEY unique_engineer_date (engineer_id, date)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roster_automation_flow_conflicts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  engineer_id INT NOT NULL,
  date DATE NOT NULL,
  old_shift_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  new_shift_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  resolved_by VARCHAR(100),
  FOREIGN KEY (engineer_id) REFERENCES roster_automation_flow_engineers(id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roster_web_temp_sessions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  conflict_data JSON NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_user_id (user_id),
  INDEX idx_expires_at (expires_at)
);
